parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text to convert to speech. Add inline vocal tags in angle brackets, e.g. <laugh>, <sigh>, <short pause>. In multi-speaker mode, write each turn as a '<speaker>: <text>' line.

parameters.name: voice
parameters.description: Voice preset to use for speech synthesis. Ignore if you are using multi-speaker config.

parameters.name: multiSpeakerConfig
parameters.description: Map speaker names to voices. Up to 2 speakers. Leave empty to use the single Voice option above. Each row must set a non-empty Speaker name, and the text must start with a '<speaker>: ' line using one of these names; lines without a speaker prefix continue the previous turn.

fields.name: speaker
fields.description: Label as it appears in the text before a colon

parameters.array_note: Pass an array, even for a single value — a bare value is ignored.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language for speech synthesis (auto-detected if not specified)

next_step.instructions: Optional: prompt_spark rewrites a short or underspecified prompt into an on-model one — pass your draft or the user intent as prompt (model_id is required), then use its recommended_call.parameters as the model_run parameters, as-is or edited. Skip it when the user wants their exact prompt used verbatim.
